name: vyokky/GUI-360
description:
GUI-360°: A Comprehensive Dataset And Benchmark For Computer-Using Agents
	

Paper | Code
GUI-360° is a large-scale, comprehensive dataset and benchmark suite designed to advance Computer-Using Agents (CUAs). 

	
		
		🎯 Key Features
	


🔢 1.2M+ executed action steps across thousands of trajectories
💼 Popular Windows office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
📸 Full-resolution screenshots with accessibility metadata
🎨 Multi-modal trajectories with reasoning traces
✅ Both… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/vyokky/GUI-360.
